title: Nadiya Ke Paar
desc: Chandan and Gunja, village sweethearts, face heartbreak when Gunja must marry her brother-in-law after her sister's death, forcing them apart and testing their love in unexpected ways.

title: Raid 2
desc: Income Tax officer Amay Patnaik takes on a corrupt nexus in Bhoj, exposing Dada Bhai's sinister empire. As deceit unravels, one question remains-can truth defeat power?

title: Kick
desc: Devi, addicted to adventures, breaks up with Shaina, a psychiatrist in Warsaw. His daredevil pursuits test love, freedom, and the cost of chasing thrill over stability.

title: Go Goa Gone
desc: Three friends visit a remote island in Goa for a rave party, but the next morning they wake up stranded and hunted by dangerous, flesh-eating zombies.

title: Tumbbad
desc: A family builds a shrine for Hastar, a dangerous monster. When they try to take his cursed treasure, scary things start happening, and their lives turn into a nightmare.

title: Badal
desc: After witnessing his family's massacre in a riot, Badal is raised by a terrorist and grows up seeking revenge against the police officer he believes is responsible.

title: Prem Rog
desc: Shunned after her husband's death, Manorama finds hope in Deodhar, her childhood friend, who challenges societal norms to restore her dignity and help her rebuild her life.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Ek Deewane ki Deewaniyat
desc: When a powerful politician falls for a strong-willed superstar, their intense romance spirals into a perilous clash of desire and ego, turning love into a battle of passion and heartbreak.

title: Tezaab
desc: After his parents' murder, Mahesh is imprisoned and separated from Mohini, who suffers under her cruel father. Years later, he returns to rescue her and avenge his past.

title: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
desc: An astrologer foretells a bright future for Raja, an idle young man, who falls for Shalu, a millionaire's daughter. Her father insists Raja must work hard and earn money to win her hand.

title: Kakuda
desc: A newlywed bride, fearing her husband will die in 13 days due to a village ghost's curse, seeks the help of a ghost hunter to save him from the looming danger.

title: Phone Bhoot
desc: Two young men start a ghost-catching business inspired by childhood stories. Their work turns dangerous when they must face a poltergeist and keep a promise that could cost them dearly.

title: Kasoor
desc: Shekhar, accused of killing his wife, hires Simran, a flawless lawyer. Convinced of his innocence, she grows close to him, unaware of his dangerous true intentions.

title: Aitraaz
desc: Raj, a married man, is falsely accused of rape by his ex-girlfriend, now his boss's wife. Pushed to the edge, he fights back by suing her for sexual harassment despite pressure.
